vad.reason: No pinned local WebRTC VAD implementation is installed; this energy-only profile must not be described as izzi-audio-candidates-1.

frame_analysis.spectrum_normalization: magnitude divided by its sum; an all-zero spectrum remains zero
frame_analysis.spectral_flux: L2 distance between adjacent normalized magnitude spectra

candidate_windows.band_rule: floor(i * decoded_samples / 10) boundaries; candidate start and end must both remain within one band
candidate_windows.overlap_rule: ranked alternatives within a band and system-proposal windows must not overlap

normalized_features.energy_change: clip(mean internal absolute adjacent-frame RMS dBFS change / 6, 0, 1)
normalized_features.silence_boundary: mean of silent-frame fractions in the 0.5 seconds immediately before start and after end; missing context contributes zero
normalized_features.timeline_coverage: one minus distance from the center of feasible in-band starts divided by half their span
normalized_features.feature_diversity: minimum Euclidean distance from prior greedy references over activity, energy-change, spectral-flux, and silence-boundary, divided by 2; one when no reference exists

ranking.alternative_references: rank-one candidates from prior bands plus earlier-ranked non-overlapping candidates in the current band

candidate_identity.feature_vector_hash: SHA-256 of canonical rounded raw and normalized acoustic features
candidate_identity.candidate_id: ec1- plus first 20 hex characters of SHA-256 over source hash, profile hash, start sample, end sample, and feature-vector hash
